definition: A reusable, parameterized structure for constructing prompts, with placeholders filled in with task-specific content at runtime.
details: Prompt templates help standardize and version prompt logic in production AI applications, making it easier to test, compare, and maintain consistent prompting behavior across a system.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Prompt Template.
